name: Breeze ChMS
shortDescription: A church management platform with flat-rate US-dollar pricing, a 30-day trial and people, giving and service-planning tools.
suitableContexts: Churches that prefer a flat subscription rather than contact-based tiers

pricing.summary: The supplier publishes one US-dollar monthly rate for Breeze ChMS, with separate transaction and excess messaging charges.

startingPrice.qualifier: Flat ChMS subscription; payment processing and some messaging charges are separate

editorial.assessment: Breeze provides a simple published subscription structure and a broad feature set. UK churches should confirm payment availability, Gift Aid workflows, currency exposure and data-protection arrangements before proceeding.
bestFor: Churches that want predictable contact-independent ChMS pricing
Teams that want a trial and sample-data demo
strengths: A 30-day trial and instant demo are available
limitations: Pricing is published in US dollars
Gift Aid and UK-specific payment support have not been confirmed

seo.title: Breeze ChMS: UK church software profile
seo.description: Independent Breeze ChMS profile covering flat-rate pricing, its trial and core features, with UK Gift Aid and payment unknowns highlighted.
